items.source: RelationalEvent that represents a change to an aggregate and therefore has an AggregateChange
items.translation: RelationalEvent，它表示聚合的变化，因此具有一个 AggregateChange

items.source: Interface for RelationalEvents which have an Identifier but might not have an entity.
items.translation: 具有RelationalEvent的接口，这些事件包含一个Identifier，但可能不包含实体。

items.source: Base class to implement domain class specific ApplicationListener classes.
items.translation: 实现特定领域类专用的ApplicationListener类的基类。

items.source: An EntityCallback that gets invoked after an aggregate was converted from the database into an entity.
items.translation: 一个在将聚合从数据库转换为实体后调用的 EntityCallback。

items.source: An EntityCallback that gets called after an aggregate got deleted.
items.translation: 一个在聚合被删除后调用的 EntityCallback。

items.source: An EntityCallback that gets invoked after an aggregate was saved to the database.
items.translation: 一个在聚合被保存到数据库后调用的EntityCallback。

items.source: An EntityCallback that gets invoked before the aggregate is converted into a database change.
items.translation: 一个在将聚合转换为数据库变更之前被调用的 EntityCallback。

items.source: An EntityCallback that gets invoked before an entity is deleted.
items.translation: 一个在删除实体之前被调用的 EntityCallback。

items.source: An EntityCallback that gets invoked before changes are applied to the database, after the aggregate was converted to a database change.
items.translation: 一个在将聚合转换为数据库变更之后、但在将这些变更应用到数据库之前被调用的 EntityCallback。

items.source: Base class for mapping events of Spring Data Relational
items.translation: Spring Data 关系型数据映射事件的基类

items.source: Gets published after instantiation and setting of all the properties of an entity.
items.translation: 在实体实例化并设置所有属性后发布。

items.source: Gets published after deletion of an entity.
items.translation: 实体删除后发布。

items.source: Gets published after a new instance or a changed instance was saved in the database.
items.translation: 在新实例或已更改的实例保存到数据库后发布。

items.source:
Gets published before an aggregate gets converted into a database change, but after the decision was made if an
insert or an update is to be performed.
items.translation: 在聚合转换为数据库变更之前发布，但在决定执行插入还是更新操作之后发布。

items.source: Gets published when an entity is about to get deleted.
items.translation: 在实体即将被删除时发布。

items.source: Gets published before changes are applied to the database, after the aggregate was converted to a database change.
items.translation: 在将聚合转换为数据库变更之后、但在对数据库应用这些变更之前发布。

items.source: Wrapper for an identifier of an entity.
items.translation: 实体标识符的包装器。

items.source: Super class for events produced during deleting an aggregate.
items.translation: 删除聚合期间产生的事件的基础类。

items.source: an event signalling JDBC processing.
items.translation: 一个表示 JDBC 处理的事件。

items.source: An event that is guaranteed to have an entity.
items.translation: 一个保证拥有实体的事件。

items.source: Events triggered during saving of an aggregate.
items.translation: 在聚合保存期间触发的操作。

items.source: Interface for events which are guaranteed to have an entity.
items.translation: 保证包含实体的事件接口。
